description: Search remote and non-classroom jobs for teachers leaving the classroom on Exit Ticket (https://exitticketjobs.com). Filter by kind of work, US state and fully remote. Returns counts for every match (total_matching, free_preview_matching, locked_matching) and the free preview listings that match, in full: title, employer, posted pay, work mode, location, states, sector and a link to the listing page. Listings outside the free preview are counted only; a plan on the site shows their employer, pay and apply link. Data is re-read from employers' own career sites (Workday, Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby) when the board is rebuilt; each result gives data_updated_at.

limit.description: How many free preview listings to return, 1 to 20. Default 10. Counts always cover every match.

remote_only.description: Only fully remote listings (work mode remote). Default false.

role.description: Kind of work. One of: instructional-design (Instructional design), training (Training and L&D), curriculum (Curriculum and content), customer-success (Customer success), sales (Ed-tech sales), program (Programs and advising), online-teaching (Online teaching).

state.description: A US state as a 2-letter code ("TX") or full name ("Texas"), any case. Matches listings that name the state, plus remote listings open across the US.

name: search_jobs
title: Search jobs for former teachers
